data.title: Elite Exteriors Reviews - Arlington, TX - Angie's List

reviews.text: We can’t say enough great things about Santos and his crew! They were very accommodating and professional through the whole process! They went above and beyond to ensure we were happy. Price was very reasonable and they completed our new siding in the time they said they would. Once they were done, they cleaned up so thoroughly that you would never even know they were here! This was one of the best remodel project experiences I have ever had. I would recommend them to everyone who needs work done to their house!
reviews.author: Karen Kelly

reviews.text: Exterior updated. Great team. Excellent price. Love the work. I will definitely reach out to them if I need them again. Very Happy!
reviews.author: Brenda Poulignot

reviews.text: My house was in need of siding replacement. I searched for a contractor and was impressed by the reviews. Santos came out and gave me a quote that I felt was very reasonable considering the amount of work involved. They installed hardie board, which is the best quality exterior siding. They completed the job in 2 1/2 days. I was amazed and pleased with the abilities of the workers. They were also very courteous and respectful. They kept the trash cleaned up as they worked and did a careful search for bits of trash after the job was finished. They were very careful about paint overspray and spent a lot of time installing paper to prevent overspray. They also painted the entire exterior including the gutters and exterior doors. I was advised of the start date and arrival time and they arrived on time. I highly recommend this company.
reviews.author: Norman Smith

reviews.text: Replaced siding with Hardie board, replaced all of the windows and exterior painting, and remodeling of my porch. This company was so wonderful to work with. From Santos giving me a quote and helping me pick out colors to Jose and “the crew” doing a beautiful job fixing up my house. This team of guys were so professional. They started and ended the same time every day and worked hard in between. I was not looking forward to this process but Elite Exteriors made this experience for me so easy. I love them so much I’m looking for more work to give them. :-). My house is so beautiful now because of them.
reviews.author: Kaylene Kohn

reviews.text: I was so impressed by Elite Exteriors reviews and Santos’ pride in the Medina’s company receiving an award from the James Hardie CEO, I had them replace my 1980 rotting siding with Hardie Select Cedarmill without even signing the contract(until completion).  They include a 15 year labor warranty!Jose and the crew of craftsmen worked their magic in May and now my home’s exterior looks great(unlike the yard).  They utilize an efficient, team approach.  The first day, they hustled to get the old siding off and Tyvek wrap on before the afternoon rain arrived.  Jose quickly had my front door working right for the first time in years without even being asked and even put my insulation strips on it. Santos worked with me on price to add insulation board, replace my shed siding and upstairs windows.  No more single panes!   I plan to use them again.  They stand by their work and are experts with Hardie board.  It’s the only siding they work with! Muchas gracias, Elite!!
reviews.author: Paul Rohack

reviews.text: Santos, Jose, and their team are by far the best contractors that I have ever worked with and I have used a few. They do what they say, are on time, and keep the work place very clean while doing the job. They replaced all of the Masonite siding and trim on our house and workshop with Hardie Board and painted everything. Our 37 year old house house looks amazing and we couldn’t be happier with the job they did for us. I had never dealt with them before, but you will not be disappointed if you go with Santos and Jose at Elite Exteriors.
reviews.author: Terry Wallace

reviews.text: We cannot speak highly enough of our experience with Santos and his crew at Elite Exteriors!  We contracted them to replace the siding and soffits, paint, and install new gutters at our home. Santos and his crew also built out a custom box for a roll-down sun shade we had customized for our back patio. All work was done on time and to our expectations, which are always lofty.  Santos was attentive to every question or perceived issue along the way. If something needed to be tweaked, he did it. We weren’t nickel and dimed during the process.  As a matter of fact, Santos and his crew went above and beyond to ensure the end result was perfect. It’s important to note that our project took 4 days in total, and before they left each day, they completely cleaned up their work areas!  Not a lot of companies do that.  If you want it done right at a fair price, we recommend you give Elite Exteriors a shot!
reviews.author: Sean Malecha

reviews.text:
Working with Santos and his family and crew was a terrific experience from start to finish. They care about their customers. We had our entire two story house done during summer 2019 - all the trim and siding completely replaced with hardy board. Elite Exteriors even built a front porch railing and installed all new exterior lighting and gutters for us as well. They took pride in their work and had great attention to the small details. Our siding was in bad shape. We are so pleased with the results.

We took our time in researching and selecting which vendor to work with being such an important investment in our home. There were very few local certified installers for hardy board when looking on James Hardy website for recommendations. We reached out for quotes from 3 vendors. One does not offer financing anymore, leaving us with two bids. Elite was a much better price and the personal service was way above that from the larger vendor. Santos was true to his word. No issues at all with communication. He took care of us from beginning to end and the final results for our 1960's home was beautiful! I would highly recommend Elite for any of your exterior needs. They certainly have a life long customer with us!
reviews.author: Michelle Ingram

data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic. They contain specific, credible details about projects, crews, and outcomes. The high ratings are consistent across Google, Angi, and Yelp, and are supported by a substantial volume of reviews (150+ on Google, 111 on Angi). The BBB A+ accreditation and lack of visible complaints further bolster credibility. There are no red flags for fake reviews or concerning complaint patterns.

positive_evidence: Review explicitly mentions a 15-year labor warranty as a selling point.

authentic_signals: Specific project details (Hardie board siding, window replacement, painting, gutters)
Mix of recent and older reviews (6 years to 2 weeks)
Emotionally authentic language expressing satisfaction and relief
data.discrepancy_explanation: All available ratings are consistently high (4.2 to 4.9). The BBB A+ rating and accreditation support a reputable business profile. The low Yelp review count (5) is typical for contractors on that platform and does not indicate a discrepancy in quality perception.
